- If non-const (my choice): `do_format` is non-const, `formatters_` is non-const, `std::get` returns non-const ref, calling `.format(...)` works with both const and non-const element formatter `format`. But elements are const, so non-const element formatter `format` would fail at the `std::get<...>(value.tuple)` binding anyway.

So both work for const-formattable elements. The non-const choice is slightly more permissive but doesn't actually help (since elements are const).
